name: CacheAlter
description: Rewrites the anonymous page-cache key: strips UTM/click-id query params and mixes in a 'cache_context' cookie value.
project_description: Two HTTP stack middlewares that change how Drupal's anonymous page cache is keyed. One middleware (ClearRequest) strips marketing query parameters (utm_source, utm_medium, utm_campaign, utm_term, utm_content, gclid, yclid, ysclid) from the incoming request's query and the rebuilt REQUEST_URI/QUERY_STRING so that ad-referral URLs differing only by those params share a single page_cache entry instead of fragmenting it. The other (CacheAlter, installed by swapping core's http_middleware.page_cache class) appends the value of a 'cache_context' cookie to the cache id, letting a site serve different anonymous static caches per cookie value (for example a selected city or region). The module has no admin UI, routes, permissions, config, database access, external calls, or output rendering. The 3.x major requires Drupal core ^11 || ^12.
